meta.name: ss-learn
meta.description: Capture a human-approved UI design lesson as a privacy-minimized local StyleSeed candidate, review it, and prepare an opt-in share package without transmitting project code, prompts, screenshots, or brand data. Use when a person asks StyleSeed to remember, learn from, generalize, review, or prepare a reusable rule from an accepted design correction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 留住你认可的设计修正,生成可复用的样式规则
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让每次界面微调都被记住、复用到以后的设计中。
copy.tagline_en: Save approved design tweaks as reusable style rules
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want every UI tweak to be remembered and reused in future designs.

howto.what: 装上此技能后，当你认可某次UI设计修改，Claude会把它整理成一条通用规则草稿，保存在你电脑本地，不自动上传；经你同意后，它还能准备一个清理过敏感信息的分享包，供你选择是否分享。
howto.when: 当你说出“记住”、“学习”、“概括”等词，要求把一次已认可的设计修改变成可复用规则，或想准备分享时触发。

say.text: 请把这个按钮配色修改记为可复用规则。
say.note: Claude会生成候选规则待你审查。

say.text: 把这条设计修正概括成一条通用原则。
say.note: Claude会先保存草稿，再请你确认。

say.text: 准备分享这条规则给团队内网。
say.note: Claude会生成不含敏感信息的分享包。

howto.what_en: After you approve a UI design fix, Claude turns it into a generalized rule draft stored locally on your machine, with no automatic uploads; after your consent, it can prepare a sanitized share package that you may choose to share.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to 'remember', 'learn', or 'generalize' an accepted design fix, or to prepare a reusable rule.

say_en.text: Please record this button color change as a reusable rule.
say_en.note: Claude creates a candidate for your review.

say_en.text: Generalize this design fix into a reusable principle.
say_en.note: Claude saves a draft, then asks for confirmation.

say_en.text: Prepare this rule for sharing with the team intranet.
say_en.note: Claude produces a sanitized share package.
